title: SHABBIR KA CHEHLUM HAI
body:
Zindaa'n ke alam seh kar jab Waarise Gham aaye
Karbal ki fazaaon me paabande sitam aaye
Faryaad o fughan karte sab Ahle Haram aaye
<<MINI>>
Zainab ne kaha Utho Abbas ke Ham aaye
Shabbir ka Chehlum hai Shabbir ka Chehlum hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Phir Dukhtar e Zehra par aafat ki ghadi aayi
The shaam ki raahon me har simt tamashaai
Aur taug me jakda tha Abid ka gala Bhai
<<MINI>>
Zainab ne kaha Utho Abbas ke Ham aaye
Shabbir ka Chehlum hai Shabbir ka Chehlum hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Gaalo'n pa Sakina ke wo neel tamacho'n ke
Zakhmi tha badan Uska durron ki azeeyat se
Har gaam pa kehti thi Ammu hain kahan Mere
<<MINI>>
Zainab ne kaha Utho Abbas ke Ham aaye
Shabbir ka Chehlum hai Shabbir ka Chehlum hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Darbar wo hakim ka Sar nange Tera kunba
Chaadar ke ewaz Ham ne baalon se kiya parda
Bhayya Teri Zainab ke baazu the rasan basta
<<MINI>>
Zainab ne kaha Utho Abbas ke Ham aaye
Shabbir ka Chehlum hai Shabbir ka Chehlum hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Roodaad e safar kaise Sughra ko sunaungi
Hain neel jo baazu par Kis tarha chhupaungi
Poochhe jo agar Tum ko kya Usko bataaungi
<<MINI>>
Zainab ne kaha Utho Abbas ke Ham aaye
Shabbir ka Chehlum hai Shabbir ka Chehlum hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ehsaas ki duniya ka purdard tha wo manzar
Tha hashr bapa Agha Zainab ka baya'n sunkar
Zindaa'n me Sakina ko kho aayi TeriKhwahar
<<MINI>>
Zainab ne kaha Utho Abbas ke Ham aaye
Shabbir ka Chehlum hai Shabbir ka Chehlum hai
author: Agha Ali Hussain
